title: Mochizuki Honami — Even Though I Shouldn't...〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line:
Hey, Mochizuki.
What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I felt that I needed to thank you is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate what you did for me the other day when I had to skip the Cleanup Committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, when you said you had to go somewhere? The seniors didn't seem to care, so I think you're in the clear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, but you were a lifesaver then.
After school
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona, wanna go home together?
Ichi and Shiho said they have work today♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure, that sounds nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to apologize to Saki about that I did too...)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The Doll Festival party was so much fun! Our games of Old Maid and President got so heated too♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so funny how every game of Old Maid had you, Ichika and Tsukasa as the last three in the end too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha...
One game just wouldn't end because we kept picking the joker from each others' hands.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was hoping to apologize to her now, but she's in such a good mood right now. Maybe it can wait until later...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the way, Hona...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I, um... I'm sorry about the other day...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa told me everything.
He said that you went all the way over to his school to tell him that I wasn't mad anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You even skipped your committee meeting to do it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?! How do you know about that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I sort of heard you talking to another girl in my class about the Cleanup Committee and kind of worked things out from there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You had to be so worried about skipping too. I feel terrible for making you do that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I want to apologize, Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, Saki, you don't have to do that!
I'm the one who lied to you about it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Time out! Stop right there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa and I are the ones that started all this, so there is absolutely no reason for you to be apologizing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lalala! I can't hear you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were the reason that Tsukasa and I were able to make up in the end, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So thank you, Hona!
Thank you for your concern!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Even though I shouldn't have done what I did but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad I worked up the courage to go through with it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's up?
Wait! No apologizing, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know.
So...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're very welcome!
